definitions.full: H2477. Chalach חֲלַח proper name, of a location a city or district under Assyrian control , whither Israel captives were taken 2Kin 17:6 = 18:11 , 1Chr 5:26 , compare –ala——u in Mesopotamia, Schr COT on 2Kin 17:8 ; > Hal Mél.
